referencePack.provider: local Three.js rendering of exact mesh
referencePack.coordinateSystem: glTF meters, Y up, face +Z; left means anatomical +X
limitations: Rendered back shows existing mesh paint, not independent evidence of correct hidden-surface design.
Strike poses are an authored proposal on a compatible fitted arm rig; they are not a baked or approved attack clip.

motionStatus.strike: authored pose proposal; not an approved attack

steps.gate: Hero identity, all six views, palette and walk/strike references reviewed together. A generated back is a proposal until approved.
Compare silhouette and limb separation in six cameras. Preserve raw reconstruction. Do not infer geometry from a composite sheet.
Inspect lit, albedo and clay. Use calibrated visible views and material regions; reject front-to-back leakage. Preserve 4K paint when supplied.
Fit joints and weights to this anatomy. Check both soles: heel-flat-toe, lateral bank, contact and clearance. Inspect wrist fit, digit webbing max strain and all clip seams.
Require owner animation approval and artifact-bound checks. Preserve source mesh, rig, paint and receipts.

scope: Vey repair is exact-source fitted. Other anatomy uses a draft rig until fitted and reviewed; a concept sheet does not perform rigging.
